com.vector.cfg.persistency.groovy.api

Interface IPersistencyApi


  • @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IPersistencyApi
    The IPersistencyModelImportApi API provides methods which allow to import and export model data.
    The persistency API provides methods which allow to import and export model data from and to files. The files are normally in the AUTOSAR .arxml format.
    To access the import functionality use one of the getModelImport() or modelImport(Closure) methods.

    All method parameters and return values must be non-null unless documented otherwise.
